body:
HCP is proud to present an educational webinar highlighting Meaningful Use. Please join us for this 30 minute webinar which will help you prepare for and manage Meaningful Use in your organization. Topics will include:

  • Meaningful Use Basics
  • Core Objectives
  • Menu Set Objectives
  • Clinical Quality Measures
  • Audit Processes

This is an excellent webinar to attend for anyone who is currently managing a compliance program with responsibilities for choosing, documenting and attaining the Meaningful Use objectives for your practice. Whether you are a Meaningful use novice or veteran, you'll receive timely and helpful instruction for your program. We will also be introducing our new online tools and resources to help clients manage their Meaningful Use Program including audit and attestation support. Each participant will receive a free Meaningful Use Checklist. There will be a live question and answer segment that we encourage you to participate in as well. Please let us know if you'd like to attend. Send an email requesting a virtual seat for this webinar to: [email protected] . Please note "Meaningful Use Webinar" in the subject line.
